description: Powdered sugar processed and packaged in Mexico, containing 95 percent or more by dry weight of U.S.-origin refined sugar.
hts_note: Classified as refined cane or beet sugar in solid form, specifically confectioners' or powdered sugar not containing added flavoring or coloring matter.

description: Wooden window shade slats designed to function specifically as components for window shades.
hts_note: Classified under other articles of wood as blinds, shutters, screens, and shades, or parts thereof.

description: Steel pods, designated as Pod-A and Pod-C, where Pod-A features vertical load-bearing members that do not exceed two inches in width.
hts_note: Steel storage pods and racking structures are classified as other structures and parts of structures of iron or steel under heading 7308.

description: Cable display systems imported as finished goods kits containing all components necessary for assembly and installation, consisting of steel cables, fittings milled from extruded aluminum, anchors, screws, and Allen wrenches.
hts_note: Classified as other articles of aluminum under GRI 3(b), as the extruded aluminum fittings impart the essential character to the cable display kit.

description: Fourteen models of passenger vehicle and light truck wheels characterized by specific physical dimensions and specifications, including rim size, offset, bolt pattern, hub bore size, and load rating.
hts_note: Classified as aluminum road wheels for passenger vehicles under subheading 8708.70.

description: Steel pods, including model Pod-C, which is a standalone welded pod without vertical or horizontal supports, and model Pod-A, which includes additional supports and is not prepackaged for retail sale.
hts_note: Steel pods are fabricated structures or parts of structures of iron or steel classified under heading 7308.

description: A flatbed utility cart lacking a projecting edge or toe plate, designed for transporting items.
hts_note: Classified as other non-mechanically propelled vehicles, such as utility carts and hand-pushed flatbed transport carts.

description: Steel wheels composed of rims and discs manufactured from steel plates.
hts_note: Steel road wheels composed of rims and discs for motor vehicles are classified as steel road wheels under heading 8708.

description: Hubs and caps of the PFT Hub & Cap System, consisting of forged steel fittings including butt weld hubs and mating caps.
hts_note: Classified as butt welding tube or pipe fittings of iron or nonalloy steel under heading 7307.

description: Flatbed utility carts designed for transporting goods.
hts_note: Classified as other non-mechanically propelled vehicles, such as hand-propelled utility and flatbed carts for transporting goods.

description: Screw covers consisting of aluminum extrusion components sold as two separate parts.
hts_note: Screw covers made of aluminum extrusion components are classified as other articles of aluminum, not elsewhere specified.

description: Ceramic roofing tiles imported together as a complete roof kit.
hts_note: Ceramic roofing tiles, even when imported as a complete kit for a roof, are specifically classified under heading 6905 as roofing tiles.

description: Certain steel wheels having a diameter of 22.5 and 24.5 inches.
hts_note: Steel road wheels of these diameters are typical for heavy-duty commercial vehicles and classified under parts and accessories of motor vehicles as other road wheels.

description: GPI Xantech DF40 and GPI Xantech DF40-D are products manufactured from and containing xanthan gum.
hts_note: Xanthan gum in primary forms is specifically provided for under HTSUS subheading 3913.90.2000.

description: Xanthan gum products identified as GPI Purexan 80AN, GPI Purexan 200AN, and GPI Quickxan 70.
hts_note: Xanthan gum is classified as a natural polysaccharide polymer in primary forms under subheading 3913.90.2015.

description: T-Type tires lacking a 'P' or 'LT' prefix, with numerical size designations not listed in the 'P' or 'LT' tables of the Tire and Rim Association Year Book, and not sized to fit passenger cars or light trucks.
hts_note: Because these pneumatic tires are not sized or intended for passenger cars, light trucks, buses, or other specific vehicles of heading 4011, they are classified under the residual category for other new pneumatic tires.

description: Feedstock intended exclusively for the manufacture of window blinds rather than for architectural accessories or building uses.
hts_note: Classified as parts of Venetian blinds of plastics under heading 3925.

description: Large diameter welded pipes made of Grade L450 steel, measuring 18 inches in outside diameter, suitable for transporting oil or gas.
hts_note: Classified as welded line pipe of iron or steel used for oil or gas pipelines with an external diameter exceeding 406.4 mm (18 inches), longitudinally submerged arc welded.

description: Machined aluminum extrusions made from an Aluminum Association series 6 alloy intended for use as heat sinks.
hts_note: Machined aluminum extrusions advanced beyond basic profiles and intended as general-purpose heat sinks are classified as other articles of aluminum.

description: Whole garlic cloves packed and preserved in brine.
hts_note: Garlic provisionally preserved in brine is classified under subheading 0711.90.5000.

description: Adult-sized memory foam mattresses for hospital beds measuring 34.5 inches wide, 77.5 inches long, and 5.9 inches in depth, imported with or without covers.
hts_note: Classified as an adult mattress of cellular rubber or plastics under subheading 9404.21.0010.

description: Flow Wall wooden storage cabinets designed to be mounted and held in place using brackets and rails.
hts_note: Wall-mounted wooden storage cabinets are classified as other wooden furniture under heading 9403 in accordance with Chapter 94 Note 2(a).

description: TR-900 series tires bearing a sidewall 'TR' marking that designates the tread pattern rather than a size designation, lacking a 'DOT' symbol on the sidewall at the time of importation, and not sized for use on trucks or buses.
hts_note: New pneumatic radial tires of rubber designed for industrial handling vehicles such as forklifts with a rim size not exceeding 61 cm.

description: Mattresses assembled using U.S.-origin mattress cores.
hts_note: Mattresses featuring foam or cellular plastic/rubber cores are classified as mattresses of cellular rubber or plastics under subheading 9404.21.0000.

description: Wall standoffs and components thereof made of extruded aluminum, used for mounting fixtures or panels at a distance from a wall.
hts_note: Wall standoffs designed to mount fixtures or display panels to a wall are classified as base metal brackets and similar fixtures.

description: Flexographic photopolymer printing plates containing no aluminum, designed for use in printing applications.
hts_note: Classified as plates, cylinders, and other printing components prepared for printing purposes under heading 8442.

description: Eighty-three models of aftermarket light and medium truck wheels defined by specific rim sizes, offsets, bolt patterns, hub bore sizes, and load capacities.
hts_note: Classified as aftermarket road wheels for motor vehicles, typically cast aluminum alloy wheels for trucks under heading 8708.

description: Wooden feedstock designed for use in manufacturing slats, bottom rails, and valances for window blinds.
hts_note: Wooden feedstock profiled continuously along its edges or faces for window blind components is classified as continuously shaped nonconiferous wood.

description: Welded carbon and alloy steel line pipe (other than stainless steel) with a nominal outside diameter exceeding 406.4 mm (16 inches), meeting the specifications for ASTM grades A671, A672, and A691, used to transport oil, gas, or natural gas liquids.
hts_note: Welded steel line pipe with an external diameter exceeding 406.4 mm for oil and gas pipelines, longitudinally submerged arc welded, of carbon/nonalloy steel.

description: Youth or adult mattresses consisting of a mattress core made of innersprings, foam, or other resilient filling, assembled with a cover.
hts_note: Youth or adult mattresses with a spring interior are typically classified under subheading 9404.29.1005.

description: Wall standoffs and components thereof composed of 6xxx-series aluminum extrusions fabricated through processes including machining, threading, and anodizing.
hts_note: Wall standoffs used for mounting signage or panels are classified as base metal brackets and similar fixtures under heading 8302.

description: Walk-behind lawn mowers assembled with a cutting deck shell and an engine, designed for cutting grass.
hts_note: Classified as non-riding, powered lawn mowers with a horizontal rotating cutting device (rotary mowers).

description: Brake hose fittings designed to convey noncorrosive fluid through a machine that powers pumps, motors, and engines.
hts_note: Classified as other tube or pipe fittings of iron or steel, specifically hydraulic and brake hose fittings.

description: Mattress covers constructed without an inner core of innersprings, foam, or other resilient filling materials.
hts_note: Mattress covers lacking an inner core or filling material are excluded from heading 9404 and classified as bed linen under heading 6302.

description: Precision-machined stainless steel ring-shaped components featuring modified center geometries and additional instrumentation-related elements. They are intended to interface with standardized flange systems to perform connection functions within larger piping systems.
hts_note: Classified as machined stainless steel flanges for tube or pipe systems under heading 7307.

description: Eighteen models of cut plate flanges made from stainless steel, produced via a plate-cutting process rather than forging.
hts_note: Stainless steel pipe flanges produced by cutting plate rather than forging are classified under other stainless steel flanges.

description: Magnesium extrusions, which are wrought magnesium products, used in the production of concrete and asphalt finishing tools.
hts_note: Wrought magnesium profiles and extrusions fall under other magnesium and articles thereof in heading 8104.

description: Sixty-one models of pneumatic tires designed for passenger vehicles and light trucks, featuring an 'LT' suffix marked on the tire sidewalls.
hts_note: New pneumatic radial tires of rubber marked with an 'LT' designation are classified as light truck on-the-highway tires under heading 4011.
